mapper.select: select count(*) from warehouse where status != 'DISABLED'
select count(*) from sensor_data where date(collected_at) = curdate()

select concat(w.warehouse_name, ' ', sm.metric_name, ' 接近阈值') as title, case when sd.metric_value >= sm.max_threshold then 'WARNING' else 'ATTENTION' end as level, concat('最新值 ', sd.metric_value, sm.unit, '，阈值上限 ', sm.max_threshold, sm.unit) as description from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code where sm.max_threshold is not null and sd.metric_value >= sm.max_threshold * 0.9 order by sd.collected_at desc limit 5

select sd.id as id, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, sm.metric_name as metricName, sd.metric_value as metricValue, date_format(sd.collected_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as collectedAt, sd.quality_flag as qualityFlag from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code order by sd.collected_at desc, sd.id desc limit 8

select w.id as warehouseId, w.warehouse_name as warehouseName, case when ifnull(metric_risk.max_ratio, 0) >= 1 then 68 when ifnull(metric_risk.max_ratio, 0) >= 0.9 then 82 else 95 end as healthScore, case when w.status = 'MAINTENANCE' then 'MAINTENANCE' when ifnull(metric_risk.max_ratio, 0) >= 1 then 'WARNING' when ifnull(metric_risk.max_ratio, 0) >= 0.9 then 'ATTENTION' else 'NORMAL' end as riskLevel from warehouse w left join ( select sd.warehouse_id, max(case when sm.max_threshold is not null and sm.max_threshold > 0 then sd.metric_value / sm.max_threshold else 0 end) as max_ratio from sensor_data sd join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code group by sd.warehouse_id ) metric_risk on metric_risk.warehouse_id = w.id where w.status != 'DISABLED' order by healthScore asc, w.id asc limit 6
